messages:
mira: Heads up — CVE found in logging-lib (CVE-2025-3141) that can allow log injection leading to header spoofing; upstream patch available. Need patch window and comm plan. Affects hosted API + Dedicated. Thoughts? :eyes:

alex: Do we have exploitability details? public exploit published? any customer indicators?

sam: No public exploit yet per NVD, PoC reported privately to upstream. Seems high probability but not widespread. Severity CVSS 7.8. Recommend urgent triage.

jess: SLA impact? If we patch, will we need rolling restarts that might affect p99 latency?

alex: Rolling restarts on runtime service cause short tail-head increases ~200ms for <1% traffic during pod restart. We can do gradual canary to limit.

mira: Proposal: schedule canary tonight 22:00 PT for 5% traffic, monitor 2 hours (telemetry thresholds: error rate +5%, p99 +50%), then 50% at 02:00, full at 06:00. Can we do that without violating customer SLAs? @sam

sam: Ok for hosted; Dedicated customers with reserved capacity may expect no restarts. Need to coordinate Dedicated window — propose maintenance 03:00-07:00 PT with pre-notice.

jess: Customer tiers: free/standard can be in-night patch; enterprise + dedicated require 48h notice and opt-out. Recommend sending opt-out link and fallback to previous minor version for enterprise if they opt-out.

alex: Rollout steps:

```
1) build image with patched lib
2) canary 5% 22:00
3) monitor 2h
4) promote 50% 02:00
5) finish 06:00

If errors > threshold revert to previous image.
```

alex: Also add autoscaling buffer + additional warm hosts to keep p99 stable.

mira: Who will own canary watch? @alex @sam

sam: I'll own watch 22:00-00:30, @alex takes 00:30-07:30. I'll set an incident channel `#incident/logging-lib-patch` and enable pager for oncall.

mira: Communications: draft customer notice for dedicated/enterprise. Short + link to opt-out + expected downtime: none (rolling restarts, low risk). Draft below — feedback?

jess: Draft:

```
We're applying an important security patch to our inference runtime to address a vulnerability in a logging library. This will be rolled out in stages to minimize service impact. Enterprise and Dedicated customers may opt out within 48 hours; please contact support to request deferral. No action required for most customers.
```

mira: +1. I'll post on status page and queue an email to enterprise list. @oncall-bot please schedule deploy at 22:00 PT and post updates.

oncall-bot: deploy scheduled: 22:00 PT canary 5% -> watch. Pager channel `#incident/logging-lib-patch` created.

alex: Pre-deploy checklist done: infra image built, smoke tests pass locally, helm diff clean.

sam: Monitoring dashboards set: latency, error-rate, 502/5xx, log-injection-alert. Threshold alerts to pager.

jess: Agree with plan. Let's also add a rollback playbook in runbook doc: link to runbook (internal).

mira: Thanks team. We'll re-evaluate after canary and either proceed or abort. :thumbsup:
